name: 最值得关注的Grok Bot 推文？
description: Sweeps a fixed public list of 21 Grok Bot explorers twice each weekday, morning and evening, and passes on only original posts that clear a bar for quality and reach. Replies in Chinese, posts nothing itself, and stays silent when nothing qualifies — so quiet days are the expected outcome.

official.title: Top Grok Bot tweets by Mai
official.description: Curates high-quality, high-traffic original posts from a public list of 21 Grok Bot explorers. Weekday morning & evening scans; numbered, quality-first;...
